name: DES
summary: Wide-area optical cosmology survey that, despite its dark-energy name, also studies dark matter through weak gravitational lensing, clustering, dwarf galaxies and dark subhalos.
detection_principle: DECam multiband imaging measures galaxy shapes, positions and photometric redshifts to reconstruct mass distributions statistically and constrain cosmological models jointly.

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: The official overview states that the planned six-year survey ran from 2013 to 2019 and is complete; data analysis continues.

collaboration.name: DES collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Institutional participation refers to the period covered by each source; this dossier does not claim to provide a complete membership list.

results.summary: Y3 data use lensing and clustering to test matter distributions and cosmological parameters.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
